summary: Nabors Industries filed an 8-K reporting the acquisition of Quaise Energy Series B-1 Preferred Stock through its subsidiary NETV, paying $35 million in stock consideration via 391,944 Nabors common shares. The transaction includes a collar mechanism: if Quaise sells the shares within 20 days and market value falls below $33.25 million, Nabors issues additional shares or cash; above $36.75 million, Quaise pays Nabors the excess. Registration rights obligate Nabors to file a resale prospectus. This is an equity investment with derivative-like price protection, not a classic special situation; watch collar mechanics and share overhang.
